assault, together with a number of others.
From the diary of the officer in charge of the
case, it appears that the first and second
complainants that is the first two above
mentioned, in their statements involved only
the first and third accused Tsang Tuh Dzung
and Zung Ah Ching and one Zau Ching Tsao who
has not been arrested or charged. They made
no mention of the second and fifth accused
with whom we are principally concerned.
    When after the alleged assault took place,
inquiries were made on the scene by detectives
amongst the factory workers, both male and
female, no one would come forward or give any
details of the assault or the reasons for
same. Subsequently one Feng Hai Zien came
forward and stated that he had witnessed the
assault. It appears that this witness is the
brother of one Feng Chu Ziang, a department
manager with an office on the ground floor of
the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company, in which
office the third and fourth complainants are
alleged to have been assaulted. The other
witnesses, with the exception of the complainants,
were located through the lawyer for the Nanyang
Brothers Tobacco Company.
    In a report dated April 12, 1933, Detective
Inspector R. Wardrope, who took the statements
of these witnesses, said:
page_data.zh:
-2-

袭击，以及其他多人。
从负责此案警官的日记来看，第一和第二控告人（即上述前两人）在陈述中仅涉及第一和第三被告曾笃宗（Tsang Tuh Dzung，音译）和钟阿清（Zung Ah Ching，音译）以及一名尚未被捕或起诉的赵清曹（Zau Ching Tsao，音译）。他们未提及我们要主要关注的第二和第五被告。
    在所谓袭击发生后，侦探在现场向工厂男女工人进行调查时，无人愿意出面或提供有关袭击及其原因的任何细节。随后，一名冯海贤（Feng Hai Zien，音译）出面，称他目睹了袭击。据悉，该证人是冯楚祥（Feng Chu Ziang，音译）的兄弟，冯楚祥是南洋兄弟烟草公司一楼办公室的部门经理，据称第三和第四控告人在该办公室遭到袭击。除控告人外，其他证人均由南洋兄弟烟草公司的律师找到。
    在1933年4月12日的一份报告中，负责记录这些证人证词的警探督察 R. 沃德罗普（R. Wardrope）说：

page_data.en:
-3-

"During the inquiries, taking of
statements, and court hearings, the above
witnesses created an impression that they
were very interested in the result of the
case, and not altogether unbiased. This
was more evident with the first witness,
Feng Hai Lien, than with the others, he
being more than usually anxious to give
evidence and information relative to the
assault, this being in striking contrast
to the large number of workers questioned,
who must have been witnesses but would not
come forward. The above attitude may have
been due to the fact that it was generally
thought that Feng Cha Liang, his brother,
was the person who was really meant to have
been attacked, but was absent from his office
when the trouble broke out."

The accused were charged with assault, and
after several hearings, the first, third and fourth
were found guilty, and sentenced to six months'
imprisonment for causing bodily harm, while the
second and fifth accused were found not guilty
as above related. During the course of the
trial, the evidence given by the witnesses and
the complainants was, to say the least, most
conflicting as appears from the record and reports.

The witnesses, especially as far as the
second accused is concerned, made a very bad
impression upon the trial judge. In his report,
Mr. Ru says:

"Furthermore, the judge who tried the
case told me personally that these witnesses
have not impressed him favorably, and
according to Article 285 of the Code of
Criminal Procedure, he believed he had
exercised his greatest care and best ability
in deciding this case."

Neither did the witnesses make a favorable
impression upon the Trial Advocate, Mr. T.Y. Chang,
page_data.zh:
-3-

“在调查、取证和庭审过程中，上述证人给人的印象是他们对案件结果非常感兴趣，且并非完全公正 unbiased。这一点在第一证人冯海连（Feng Hai Lien，音译）身上比其他人更为明显，他异乎寻常地急于提供与袭击有关的证据和信息，这与大量被询问但拒绝出面的工人形成了鲜明对比，而这些工人本应是目击者。上述态度可能是因为人们普遍认为冯查良（Feng Cha Liang，音译，即其兄弟）才是真正 intended 要攻击的目标，但在事态爆发时他不在办公室。”

被告被控袭击罪，经过几次听证后，第一、第三和第四被告被判犯有造成身体伤害罪，判处六个月监禁，而第二和第五被告如上所述被判无罪。在审判过程中，证人和控告人提供的证词至少可以说是极其矛盾的，这在记录和报告中有所体现。

证人们，特别是就第二被告而言，给主审法官留下了非常糟糕的印象。在其报告中，Ru 先生说：

“此外，审理此案的法官亲自告诉我，这些证人没有给他留下好印象，并且根据《刑事诉讼法》第285条，他认为自己在裁决此案时已尽了最大谨慎和努力。”

证人们也没有给出庭律师 T.Y. Chang 先生留下好印象，

page_data.en:
for in his report, he says, referring to the
testimony of the witness, Feng Hai Kien: "His
testimony seems to be a fabrication", and again,
further on in the same report, Mr. Chang says:

"There is, indeed, a wide discrepancy
between the statements made by him and
the complainants". And again,

"It seems to me that even the statements
made by the complainants are not free from
doubt.

"The first and second complainants told
the judge in the hospital that they knew the
names of those who assaulted them, as they
were laborers working under them, but in
the station, they only named Tsang Ah Ching,
Zung Ah Ching and Sau Ching Tsao, leaving
out the names of the second, third, fourth
and fifth accused."

After the judgment was rendered acquitting
the second and fifth accused as above related,
the Trial Advocate did not give notice of appeal
in accordance with our procedure in doubtful cases,
for the reason that he considered that there were
no grounds upon which to base an appeal. Subsequent
to the rendering of the judgment, Supt. Yorke sent
the file to the Trial Advocate for notation as
to whether in his opinion an appeal should be
perfected. The Trial Advocate made the following
remarks upon the file:

"No appeal. "It is true that the second
accused was identified by some complainants
as merely being present at the scene of the
crime. But this fact is not sufficient to
incriminate him as a participant in this
offence. No complaint could prove that
he was the instigator, nor was he implicated
by any of the remaining accused as a joint
offender. It is therefore my opinion that
an appeal is positively unnecessary."
page_data.zh:
因为他在报告中提到证人冯海坚（Feng Hai Kien，音译）的证词时说：“他的证词似乎是捏造的”，并在同一报告的后面再次说道：

“确实，他的陈述与控告人的陈述之间存在很大差异”。又说道，

“在我看来，即使是控告人的陈述也并非毫无疑问。

“第一和第二控告人在医院告诉法官，他们知道袭击者的名字，因为他们是受其管理的劳工，但在巡捕房，他们只指名曾阿清（Tsang Ah Ching，音译）、钟阿清（Zung Ah Ching，音译）和赵清曹（Sau Ching Tsao，音译），漏掉了第二、第三、第四和第五被告的名字。”

在上述判决宣告第二和第五被告无罪后，出庭律师并未按照我们在疑案中的程序提出上诉通知，原因是他认为没有提出上诉的依据。判决作出后，约克（Yorke）警司将卷宗送交出庭律师，请其注明在他看来是否应完善上诉程序。出庭律师在卷宗上作了如下批注：

“不上诉。“确实，一些控告人指认第二被告仅在犯罪现场出现。但这一事实不足以认定他是此罪的参与者。没有任何控告人能证明他是煽动者，也没有任何其他被告牵连他为共同罪犯。因此，我认为绝对没有必要上诉。”

page_data.en:
-6-

Then in accordance with our usual procedure,
the file was referred to the Senior Assistant
Advocate, Mr. King S. Kim, who made the following
remarks upon the file:

"The strongest evidence against the second
accused is that he was waiting at the door at
the time of the assault, and there is no
evidence to support the allegation that he is
the instigator. He further proves an alibi.
As to the fifth accused, there is no evidence
against him. I do not think an appeal is
justified."

The file then, in continuation of our usual
procedure, was referred back to the superintendent,
who made a very able report, epitomizing the
evidence and in conclusion stated:

"In view of the above, the Police suggest
an appeal against the acquittal of the second
and fifth accused."

The whole file was then referred to the
Municipal Advocate for opinion. In view of the
difference of opinion between the Police and the
Assistant Municipal Advocates, the Municipal
Advocate requested the second senior Assistant
Municipal Advocate, Mr. Paul P.Y. Ru, to examine
the official court file and report as to his
conclusions and the reasons therefor. Mr. Ru's
report is attached to the file, and in the last
paragraph thereof, he states:

"After I have thought over the above
mentioned points carefully, may I submit my
opinion that the second accused may not be
convicted and an appeal seems to be
unwarranted."

An additional report was requested from the
Trial Advocate, Mr. T.Y. Chang, from which report
page_data.zh:
-6-

随后，按照我们的常规程序，卷宗被转交高级助理律师金士金（King S. Kim，音译）先生，他在卷宗上作了如下批注：

“针对第二被告最有力的证据是他在袭击发生时在门口等候，但没有证据支持他是煽动者的指控。他还提供了不在场证明。至于第五被告，没有针对他的证据。我认为没有理由上诉。”

接着，按照我们的常规程序，卷宗被退回警司，警司撰写了一份非常有力的报告，概括了证据，并在结论中陈述：

“鉴于上述情况，警方建议对第二和第五被告的无罪判决提出上诉。”

随后，整个卷宗被转交市政律师征求意见。鉴于警方与助理市政律师之间意见不一，市政律师请求第二资深助理市政律师 Paul P.Y. Ru 先生审查官方法庭卷宗，并报告其结论及理由。Ru 先生的报告附在卷宗中，他在最后一段陈述：

“在仔细思考上述要点后，我谨提出我的意见，即第二被告可能不会被定罪，上诉似乎是没有根据的。”

此外，还要求出庭律师 T.Y. Chang 先生提交一份补充报告，我们从该报告中

page_data.en:
we have already quoted. In the concluding portion
of his report, Mr. Chang says:

"An appeal against the acquittal of the
second accused would not, in my opinion, be
sustained.

"As there is no evidence to show that
the fifth accused actually participated
in the assault, it is not advisable to
appeal from his acquittal."

Subsequent to this, and at the request of
Major Bourne, Deputy Commissioner (Crime), our
file was forwarded to the Commissioner of Police
for his remarks prior to any final opinion having
been expressed. The Commissioner of Police, in
his letter to the Municipal Advocate, states:

"As the accused were all charged with
assault, and as the Court did not consider
there was sufficient evidence to convict
the second and fifth accused, I have no
grounds upon which to urge that an appeal
should be lodged. I do, however, think
that had the accused also been charged under
Article 157 of the Criminal Code, there might
have been a good case against the second
accused. From the police point of view, the
act of rioting was a serious offence against
public order, and it is unfortunate that one
of the accused who appears to have been a
ringleader has escaped."

We have now to express our opinion on the
facts as they appear to us, and as we have
above stated them.

REASONS

We do not believe that any court would have
convicted the second and fifth accused upon the
evidence as presented. From the evidence, we think
that we are entitled to assume that it is extremely
doubtful as to whether or not the second accused
was on the premises at the time the assault was
committed. We have formed this opinion, not on
page_data.zh:
已经引用过部分内容。在报告的结尾部分，Chang 先生说：

“我认为，针对第二被告无罪判决的上诉不会得到支持。

“由于没有证据显示第五被告实际参与了袭击，因此不建议对其无罪判决提出上诉。”

此后，应副总监（刑事）伯恩（Bourne）少校的要求，我们的卷宗在任何最终意见发表之前被送往警察总监以供其批注。警察总监在给市政律师的信中表示：

“由于所有被告均被控袭击罪，且法院认为没有足够证据定罪第二和第五被告，我没有理由敦促提出上诉。然而，我认为，如果被告也被依据《刑法》第157条起诉，针对第二被告的案件可能会更有利。从警方角度来看，暴乱行为是对公共秩序的严重犯罪，不幸的是，其中一名看似为首要的被告逃脱了制裁。”

我们现在必须根据我们所见及上述陈述的事实表达我们的意见。

理由

我们认为，任何法院都不会依据所提交的证据定罪第二和第五被告。从证据来看，我们认为我们有理由假设，第二被告在袭击发生时是否在场是极其可疑的。我们形成这一意见，并非基于

page_data.en:
-7-

account of the alibi put forward by the second
accused, but because the evidence against him
is most unreliable and untrustworthy.
Under Anglo-Saxon procedure, the prosecution
cannot appeal from an acquittal and thus put a
defendant twice in jeopardy. While such is not
Chinese law, we do not feel that it would be
right for us to put the second and fifth accused
in jeopardy again upon such conflicting evidence.
The Chinese Court is always ready to convict,
provided there is some evidence, as is shown by
the high percentage of convictions and for this
reason we feel that it would not be proper for us
to press any further a case, such as this one, in
which we have so little confidence.
While we fully appreciate the fact that a riot
is a serious offence against public order, yet
persons against whom there is not sufficient evidence
cannot be convicted of such an offence. The defendant
may have been the leader of the faction opposed to
the party to which the complainants belong but
there is no convincing evidence proving that he was
the ringleader of a riot as provided in Article 157
of the Criminal Code.
We wish to express our gratitude for the
interest and zeal displayed by the Commissioner
of Police, Major Bourne, Supt, Yorke and Detective
Inspector Wardrope, which has enabled us to arrive
at what we consider to be a correct opinion.
page_data.zh:
-7-

并非基于第二名被告提出的不在场证明，而是因为针对他的证据极不可靠且不足为信。
根据英美法系程序，控方不得对无罪判决提出上诉，从而避免使被告陷入双重危险。虽然中国法律并非如此规定，但我们认为，在证据如此矛盾的情况下，让第二和第五名被告再次面临诉讼风险是不恰当的。只要有某些证据，中国法院通常都愿意作出有罪判决，高定罪率便证明了这一点；因此，我们认为，对于像本案这样我们缺乏信心的案件，不宜进一步追诉。
尽管我们充分认识到骚乱是严重危害公共秩序的罪行，但对于证据不足的人，不能以此罪名定罪。被告可能是反对原告所属派系的派系领袖，但没有令人信服的证据证明他是《刑法》第157条所规定的骚乱首要分子。
我们要对警务处处长伯恩少校（Major Bourne）、约克警司（Supt, Yorke）和沃德罗普侦探督察（Detective Inspector Wardrope）所表现出的关注和热忱表示感谢，这使我们得以形成我们认为正确的意见。

page_data.en:
-3-

CONCLUSION

In view of the foregoing, the opinion is
expressed that there should be
NO APPEAL

Dated: April 22, 1933.

R. J. Bryan, Jr.
Municipal Advocate.

-3-

结论

鉴于上述情况，现发表意见如下：
不予上诉

R. J. Bryan, Jr.

IN THE COURT OF

Shanghai Municipal Council
vs.
(1) Tsang Tuh Deung,
(2) Woo Sz Woon, alias Siau Ho Li,
(3) Lee Ah Ching, alias Aung Ah Ching,
(4) Lee Kwei, and
(5) Lee Sing Joh.

OPINION

This matter comes on for our consideration and
opinion as to whether or not the Council should appeal
from the judgment of the Shanghai First Special Area
District Court, the Honorable Judge Sico presiding,
rendered on April 5, 1933, whereby the second and
fifth accused were found not guilty.

FACTS

This case arose out of trouble and ill feeling
between two factions in the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco
Company, and which resulted in an assault upon certain
officers and employees of the company by some of the
workmen, in which some of the defendants are alleged
to be involved. The first Information Report is
signed by Lee Ts Daung, Lee Zung Yao and Leung Yoong
Kwei, the first three complainants, and mentions
specifically only the name of the first defendant,
Cheng Tuh Deung, as being involved in the alleged
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局
诉
(1) 曾德登 (Tsang Tuh Deung)，
(2) 吴思温 (Woo Sz Woon)，别名萧好利 (Siau Ho Li)，
(3) 李阿清 (Lee Ah Ching)，别名昂阿清 (Aung Ah Ching)，
(4) 李贵 (Lee Kwei)，以及
(5) 李胜祖 (Lee Sing Joh)。

意见书

此事提请我们审议并发表意见，即工部局是否应就上海第一特区地方法院于1933年4月5日作出的判决提出上诉。该判决由西科法官（Judge Sico）主持审理，裁定第二和第五名被告无罪。

事实

本案源于南洋兄弟烟草公司两派之间的纠纷和恶感，导致部分工人袭击了该公司的某些职员和员工，据称部分被告卷入其中。第一份告发书由前三名原告李茨当 (Lee Ts Daung)、李宗尧 (Lee Zung Yao) 和梁永贵 (Leung Yoong Kwei) 签署，仅具体提及第一名被告郑德登 (Cheng Tuh Deung) 的名字，称其涉嫌参与所谓的

page_data.en:
-2-

assault, together with a number of others.
From the diary of the officer in charge of the
case, it appears that the first and second
complainants that is the first two above
mentioned, in their statements involved only
the first and third accused Tsang Tuh Deung
and Sung Ah Ching and one Zou Ching Tsao who
has not been arrested or charged. They made
no mention of the second and fifth accused
with whom we are principally concerned.
When after the alleged assault took place,
inquiries were made on the scene by detectives
amongst the factory workers, both male and
female, no one would come forward or give any
details of the assault or the reasons for
same. Subsequently one Feng Hai Zien came
forward and stated that he had witnessed the
assault. It appears that this witness is the
brother of one Feng Cho Lieng, a department
manager with an office on the ground floor of
the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company, in which
office the third and fourth complainants are
alleged to have been assaulted. The other
witnesses, with the exception of the complainants,
were located through the lawyer for the Nanyang
Brothers Tobacco Company.
In a report dated April 12, 1933, Detective
Inspector R. Wardrop, who took the statements
of these witnesses, said:
page_data.zh:
-2-

袭击，以及其他多人。
从负责此案的警官日记来看，前两名原告（即上述前两人）在陈述中仅牵涉第一和第三名被告曾德登 (Tsang Tuh Deung) 和宋阿清 (Sung Ah Ching)，以及一名邹清曹 (Zou Ching Tsao)，此人未被逮捕或起诉。他们未提及我们主要关注的第二和第五名被告。
在所谓袭击发生后，侦探在现场向男女工厂工人进行调查时，无人出面提供有关袭击或其原因的任何细节。随后，一名冯海贤 (Feng Hai Zien) 出面，声称目睹了袭击。据悉，该证人是冯卓良 (Feng Cho Lieng) 的兄弟，冯卓良是南洋兄弟烟草公司一楼办公室的部门经理，据称第三和第四名原告在该办公室遭到袭击。除原告外，其他证人是通过南洋兄弟烟草公司的律师找到的。
在1933年4月12日的一份报告中，负责记录这些证人证词的沃德罗普侦探督察（R. Wardrop）说：

page_data.en:
-3-

"During the inquiries, taking of
statements, and court hearings, the above
witnesses created an impression that they
were very interested in the result of the
case, and not altogether unbiased. This
was more evident with the first witness,
Feng Hai Sien, than with the others he
being more than usually anxious to give
evidence and information relative to the
assault, this being in striking contrast
to the large number of workers questioned,
who must have been witnesses but would not
come forward. The above attitude may have
been due to the fact that it was generally
thought that Feng Cha Sieng, his brother,
was the person who was really meant to have
been attacked, but was absent from his office
when the trouble broke out."

The accused were charged with assault, and
after several hearings, the first, third and fourth
were found guilty, and sentenced to six months'
imprisonment for causing bodily harm, while the
second and fifth accused were found not guilty
as above related. During the course of the
trial, the evidence given by the witnesses and
the complainants was, to say the least, most
conflicting as appears from the record and reports.

The witnesses, especially as far as the
second accused is concerned, made a very bad
impression upon the trial judge. In his report,
Mr. Ru says:

"Furthermore, the judge who tried the
case told me personally that these witnesses
have not impressed him favorably, and
according to Article 283 of the Code of
Criminal Procedure, he believed he had
exercised his greatest care and best ability
in deciding this case."

Neither did the witnesses make a favorable
impression upon the Trial Advocate, Mr. T.Y. Chang,
page_data.zh:
-3-

“在调查、录口供和庭审期间，上述证人给人的印象是他们对案件结果非常感兴趣，且并非完全公正 unbiased。这一点在第一名证人冯海贤 (Feng Hai Sien) 身上比其他人更为明显，他异常急切地提供与袭击有关的证据和信息，这与大量被询问但拒绝出面的工人形成了鲜明对比，而这些工人本应是证人。上述态度可能是因为人们普遍认为冯查祥 (Feng Cha Sieng)（其兄弟）才是真正 intended 被攻击的目标，但在事发时他不在办公室。”

被告被控袭击罪，经过数次聆讯后，第一、第三和第四名被告被判犯有伤害身体罪，判处六个月监禁，而第二和第五名被告如上所述被判无罪。在审判过程中，证人和原告提供的证词至少可以说是极其矛盾的，这在记录和报告中均有体现。

证人们，尤其是涉及第二名被告的证词，给主审法官留下了非常糟糕的印象。茹先生（Mr. Ru）在报告中说：

“此外，审理此案的法官亲自告诉我，这些证人并未给他留下良好印象，并且根据《刑事诉讼法》第283条，他认为自己在裁决此案时已尽了最大谨慎和努力。”

证人们也未给出庭公诉人张TY先生（Mr. T.Y. Chang）留下良好印象，

page_data.en:
-4-

For in his report, he says, referring to the
testimony of the witness, Jung Ah Ching "his
testimony seems to be a fabrication", and again,
Further on in the same report, Mr. Chung says:

"There is, indeed, a wide discrepancy
between the statements made by him and
the complainants". And again,

"It seems to me that even the statements
made by the complainants are not free from
doubt.

"The first and second complainants told
the judge in the hospital that they knew the
names of those who assaulted them, as they
were laborers working under them, but in
the station, they only named Tsang Ah Ching,
Lung Ah Ching and Lau Ching Tsao, leaving
out the names of the second, third, fourth
and fifth accused."

After the judgment was rendered acquitting
the second and fifth accused as above related,
the Trial Advocate did not give notice of appeal
in accordance with our procedure in doubtful cases,
for the reason that he considered that there were
no grounds upon which to base an appeal. Subsequent
to the rendering of the judgment, Supt. Yorke sent
the file to the Trial Advocate for notation as
to whether in his opinion an appeal should be
perfected. The Trial Advocate made the following
remarks upon the file:

"No appeal. "It is true that the second
accused was identified by some complainants
as merely being present at the scene of the
crime. But this fact is not sufficient to
incriminate him as a participant in this
offense. No complainant could prove that
he was the instigator, nor was he implicated
by any of the remaining accused as a joint
offender. It is therefore my opinion that
an appeal is positively unnecessary."
page_data.zh:
-4-

因为他在报告中提到证人郑阿清 (Jung Ah Ching) 的证词时说：“他的证词似乎是捏造的”，并在同一报告的后面部分，钟先生（Mr. Chung，注：此处原文人名拼写不一致，前为Chang后为Chung，依原文保留）说：

“确实，他的陈述与原告的陈述之间存在巨大差异”。又说，

“在我看来，即使是原告的陈述也并非毫无疑问。

“第一和第二名原告在医院告诉法官，他们知道袭击者的名字，因为他们是其手下工作的劳工，但在警局，他们只指名曾阿清 (Tsang Ah Ching)、龙阿清 (Lung Ah Ching) 和刘清曹 (Lau Ching Tsao)，漏掉了第二、第三、第四和第五名被告的名字。”

在上述判决宣告第二和第五名被告无罪后，出庭公诉人并未按照我们在疑案中的程序提出上诉通知，原因是他认为没有提起上诉的依据。判决作出后，约克警司将卷宗送交出庭公诉人，请其注明是否认为应当完善上诉手续。出庭公诉人在卷宗上作了如下批注：

“不上诉。‘确实，一些原告指认第二名被告仅在犯罪现场出现。但这一事实不足以认定他参与了此项罪行。没有原告能证明他是煽动者，其他被告也没有任何人牵连他是共同罪犯。因此，我认为绝对没有必要上诉。’”

page_data.en:
-5-

Then in accordance with our usual procedure,
the file was referred to the Senior Assistant
Advocate, Mr. King C. Lam, who made the following
remarks upon the file:

"The strongest evidence against the second
accused is that he was waiting at the door at
the time of the assault, and there is no
evidence to support the allegation that he is
the instigator. He further proves an alibi.
As to the fifth accused, there is no evidence
against him. I do not think an appeal is
justified."

The file then, in continuation of our usual
procedure, was referred back to the Superintendent,
who made a very able report, epitomising the
evidence and in conclusion stated:

"In view of the above, the Police suggest
an appeal against the acquittal of the second
and fifth accused."

The whole file was then referred to the
Municipal Advocate for opinion. In view of the
difference of opinion between the Police and the
Assistant Municipal Advocates, the Municipal
Advocate requested the second senior Assistant
Municipal Advocate, Mr. Paul P.Y. Hu, to examine
the official court file and report as to his
conclusions and the reasons therefor. Mr. Hu's
report is attached to the file, and in the last
paragraph thereof, he states:

"After I have thought over the above
mentioned points carefully, may I submit my
opinion that the second accused may not be
convicted and an appeal seems to be
unwarranted."

An additional report was requested from the
Trial Advocate, Mr. T.Y. Cheng, from which report
page_data.zh:
-5-

随后，按照我们的常规程序，卷宗被转交高级助理公诉人林KC先生（Mr. King C. Lam），他在卷宗上作了如下批注：

“针对第二名被告最有力的证据是他在袭击发生时在门口等候，但没有证据支持他是煽动者的指控。他还提供了不在场证明。至于第五名被告，没有任何针对他的证据。我认为上诉没有正当理由。”

接着，按照我们的常规程序，卷宗被退回警司，警司提交了一份非常出色的报告，概括了证据，并在结论中陈述：

“鉴于上述情况，警方建议对第二和第五名被告的无罪判决提出上诉。”

随后，整个卷宗被转交工部局公诉人以征求意见。鉴于警方与助理工部局公诉人之间意见不一，工部局公诉人请求第二资深助理工部局公诉人胡P.Y.保罗先生（Mr. Paul P.Y. Hu）查阅官方法庭卷宗，并报告其结论及理由。胡先生的报告附在卷宗中，他在最后一段陈述：

“在仔细思考上述各点后，谨提出我的意见，即第二名被告可能无法被定罪，上诉似乎没有正当理由。”

随后要求出庭公诉人郑TY先生（Mr. T.Y. Cheng，注：此处原文拼写为Cheng，前文为Chang，依原文保留）提交补充报告，我们从该报告中

page_data.en:
-6-

we have already quoted. In the concluding portion
of his report, Mr. Cheng says:

"An appeal against the acquittal of the
second accused would not, in my opinion, be
sustained.

"As there is no evidence to show that
the fifth accused actually participated
in the assault, it is not advisable to
appeal from his acquittal."

Subsequent to this, and at the request of
Major Bourne, Deputy Commissioner (Crime), our
file was forwarded to the Commissioner of Police
for his remarks prior to any final opinion having
been expressed. The Commissioner of Police, in
his letter to the Municipal Advocate, states:

"As the accused were all charged with
assault, and as the Court did not consider
there was sufficient evidence to convict
the second and fifth accused, I have no
grounds upon which to urge that an appeal
should be lodged. I do, however, think
that had the accused also been charged under
Article 157 of the Criminal Code, there might
have been a good case against the second
accused. From the police point of view, the
act of rioting was a serious offence against
public order, and it is unfortunate that one
of the accused who appears to have been a
ringleader has escaped."

We have now to express our opinion on the
facts as they appear to us, and as we have
above stated them.

REASONS

We do not believe that any court would have
convicted the second and fifth accused upon the
evidence as presented. From the evidence, we think
that we are entitled to assume that it is extremely
doubtful as to whether or not the second accused
was on the premises at the time the assault was
committed. We have formed this opinion, not on
page_data.zh:
-6-

已经引用过部分内容。在报告结尾部分，郑先生说：

“我认为，针对第二名被告无罪判决的上诉不会得到支持。

“由于没有证据显示第五名被告实际参与了袭击，不建议对其无罪判决提出上诉。”

此后，应副警务处长（刑事）伯恩少校（Major Bourne）的要求，我们的卷宗在任何最终意见发表之前被 forwarded 至警务处处长征求意见。警务处处长在给工部局公诉人的信中表示：

“由于所有被告均被控袭击罪，且法院认为没有足够证据定罪第二和第五名被告，我没有理由敦促提出上诉。然而，我认为，如果被告也被依据《刑法》第157条起诉，针对第二名被告的案件可能会更有利。从警方角度来看，骚乱行为是严重危害公共秩序的罪行，不幸的是，一名看似是首要分子的被告逃脱了制裁。”

我们现在必须就呈现在我们面前的事实表达我们的意见，正如我们上文所述。

理由

我们认为，任何法院都不会依据所提交的证据对第二和第五名被告定罪。从证据来看，我们认为我们有理由假设，第二名被告在袭击发生时是否在场极具疑问。我们形成这一意见，并非基于

page_data.en:
account of the alibi put forward by the second
accused, but because the evidence against him
is most unreliable and untrustworthy.
Under Anglo-Saxon procedure, the prosecution
cannot appeal from an acquittal and thus put a
defendant twice in jeopardy. While such is not
Chinese law, we do not feel that it would be
right for us to put the second and fifth accused
in jeopardy again upon such conflicting evidence.
The Chinese Court is always ready to convict,
provided there is some evidence, as is shown by
the high percentage of convictions and for this
reason we feel that it would not be proper for us
to press any further a case, such as this one, in
which we have so little confidence.
While we fully appreciate the fact that a riot
is a serious offence against public order, yet
persons against whom there is not sufficient evidence
cannot be convicted of such an offence. The defendant
may have been the leader of the faction opposed to
the party to which the complainants belong but
there is no convincing evidence proving that he was
the ringleader of a riot as provided in Article 157
of the Criminal Code.
We wish to express our gratitude for the
interest and zeal displayed by the Commissioner
of Police, Major Bourne, Supt. Yorke and Detective
Inspector Wardrope, which has enabled us to arrive
at what we consider to be a correct opinion.
page_data.zh:
第二名被告提出的不在场证明，而是因为针对他的证据极不可靠且不足为信。
根据英美法系程序，控方不得对无罪判决提出上诉，从而避免使被告陷入双重危险。虽然中国法律并非如此规定，但我们认为，在证据如此矛盾的情况下，让第二和第五名被告再次面临诉讼风险是不恰当的。只要有某些证据，中国法院通常都愿意作出有罪判决，高定罪率便证明了这一点；因此，我们认为，对于像本案这样我们缺乏信心的案件，不宜进一步追诉。
尽管我们充分认识到骚乱是严重危害公共秩序的罪行，但对于证据不足的人，不能以此罪名定罪。被告可能是反对原告所属派系的派系领袖，但没有令人信服的证据证明他是《刑法》第157条所规定的骚乱首要分子。
我们要对警务处处长伯恩少校（Major Bourne）、约克警司（Supt, Yorke）和沃德罗普侦探督察（Detective Inspector Wardrope）所表现出的关注和热忱表示感谢，这使我们得以形成我们认为正确的意见。

page_data.en:
-8-

CONCLUSION

In view of the foregoing, the opinion is
expressed that there should be
NO TRIAL

Dated: April 22, 1933.

R. T. Bryan, Jr.
Municipal Advocate
page_data.zh:
-8-

结论

鉴于上述情况，现发表意见如下：
不予审理（NO TRIAL）

日期：1933年4月22日。

R. T. Bryan, Jr.
工部局公诉人

由于被告均被控袭击罪，且法庭认为没有足够证据定罪第2和第5名被告，因此我没有理由主张提出上诉。然而，我认为，如果被告同时也依据《刑法典》第157条被起诉，针对第2名被告的案件可能会更有利。从警方角度来看，暴乱行为是对公共秩序的严重犯罪，不幸的是，其中一名似乎是主谋的被告逃脱了。

The evidence in this case is clearly outlined

日期 1933年4月18日
（刑事股）办公室笔记

警务处处长。

本案证据在附上的 Yankai 警司报告中已有清晰概述。

第5名被告本应与其他被告一起被控“恶意破坏”。没有任何证据表明在第5名被告的案件中没有上诉的理由。（注：此处原文逻辑似有矛盾或OCR错误，直译为：没有证据表明在任何情况下都不应对第5名被告提出上诉 / 或者意为：没有证据支持对第5名被告的判决提出上诉，结合下文语境，此处可能意指缺乏对第5名被告上诉的依据）。

在我看来，针对第2名被告有良好的证据，为此请参考 Yankai 警司的摘要以及附上的 Shu. Det. May Sin 的报告。

与此相对的是中国律师的意见，他们认为不宜提出上诉。

引用公开法庭的先例，以下证据与本案有关。

3月28日。Song Hau Sei

April 10th, 1933.

Municipal Advocate,

In re Case No. 5/91323 - S.M.C.
(Wayside Station) vs. Tsang
Tuh Dzung et al

A careful perusal of the case papers submitted by
the Crime Branch of the S. M. P. and the Court record
in this case has been made and herewith follows a resume
of the evidence gathered by the Police and adduced in
Court.

INVESTIGATIONS: In Diary 1, it is stated that a
witness Feng Hai Zien told the Police on the day of the
assault that one Siau Mau Bi was present at the assault,
together with others armed with iron bars. The following
day, this witness identified Siau Mau Bi in the compound
of the S. F. S. A. D. Court, and it was ascertained that
the true and proper name of Siau Mau Bi was Woo Sz Yuen,
This man was arrested and became the second accused in
the case.

In Diary No. 2, a witness named Woo Koen Yoong is
shown as having told the Police that this second accused
led the gang which committed the assault. In the same
diary, it is shown that a witness Dzong Vung Ziang also
stated to the Police that the second accused led the gang.
Again in this diary, a third witness Tsu Woong Hwa is
on record as stating that the second accused led the gang.

In Diary No. 3, the witness Feng Hai Zie again appears
as having pointed out the fifth accused on March 22 (two
days after the assault) as one of the assailants.
page_data.zh:
1933年4月10日。

市检察官，

关于案件编号 5/91323 - 上海公共租界工部局
（路边巡捕房）诉 Tsang Tuh Dzung 等人

经仔细审阅上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事股提交的案件材料及本案的法庭记录，现概述警方收集并在法庭上提出的证据。

调查：在日记1中陈述，证人 Feng Hai Zien 在袭击当天告诉警方，Siau Mau Bi 与其他手持铁棒的人一起出现在袭击现场。第二天，该证人在上海第一特区地方法院（S. F. S. A. D. Court）的大院内指认了 Siau Mau Bi，并查明 Siau Mau Bi 的真实姓名为 Woo Sz Yuen。此人被捕并成为本案的第二名被告。

在日记第2号中，显示一名名为 Woo Koen Yoong 的证人告诉警方，这第二名被告率领了实施袭击的团伙。在同一本日记中，显示证人 Dzong Vung Ziang 也向警方陈述，第二名被告率领了该团伙。再次在这本日记中，第三名证人 Tsu Woong Hwa 有记录表明其陈述第二名被告率领了该团伙。

在日记第3号中，证人 Feng Hai Zie 再次出现，指出在3月22日（袭击后两天）指认第五名被告为袭击者之一。

page_data.en:
-2-

In Diary No. 4, one of the complaining witnesses named
Hyu Sung Ching when interviewed in hospital, told the Police
that the second accused led the gang and was shouting, "Assault,
Assault". In addition to this evidence appearing in the
diaries, there are also statements attached to the case papers
of each of these witnesses.
On page 4 of the Court Proceedings, it is shown that the
witness Feng Hai Zien testified that the fifth accused broke
windows in the factory with an iron bar. Witness Ts Yoong Wu
testified that the fifth accused was present during the assault.
Two further witnesses called for the prosecution stated they
did not notice the fifth accused.
On page 7, the witness Feng Hai Zien clearly stated that
the second accused was present during the assault, and further
was armed with an iron bar. On the same page, it is recorded
that witness Pa Kau Ming testified that the second accused
was the leader of the gang which committed the assault. On
page 10, it is shown that when the judge hearing this case
visited certain hospitals to interview the victims of this
assault, a complaining witness named Lee Ts Daung testified
that the second and fifth accused were both present during
the committal of the assault. On page 11, another complain-
ing witness whilst in hospital and in answer to the judge,
stated that the second accused was the instigator of this
assault. Further on this page, it will be seen that the third
complaining witness Tseu Kung Sung stated whilst in the
hospital that he saw the second accused at the time of the
assault. On page 14, this witness testifies in open court
that the second accused was the instigator of the assault.
To return to pages 11 and 12, it will be seen that a fourth
complaining witness, Hyu Sung Kyung, testified in hospital
that he saw the second accused during the assault.
Opposing
page_data.zh:
-2-

在日记第4号中，一名名为 Hyu Sung Ching 的控告证人在医院接受询问时告诉警方，第二名被告率领了团伙并高喊“打啊，打啊”。除了日记中出现的这些证据外，这些证人的陈述也附在各自的案件材料中。
在法庭诉讼记录第4页，显示证人 Feng Hai Zien 作证说，第五名被告用铁棒打破了工厂的窗户。证人 Ts Yoong Wu 作证说，第五名被告在袭击期间在场。另外两名被传唤为控方作证的证人表示他们没有注意到第五名被告。
在第7页，证人 Feng Hai Zien 清楚地说，第二名被告在袭击期间在场，并且手持铁棒。在同一页，记录显示证人 Pa Kau Ming 作证说，第二名被告是实施袭击的团伙的头目。在第10页，显示审理此案的法官走访某些医院采访此次袭击的受害者时，一名名为 Lee Ts Daung 的控告证人作证说，第二名和第五名被告在实施袭击时均在场。在第11页，另一名控告证人在医院回答法官提问时 stating，第二名被告是此次袭击的煽动者。进一步在这一页可以看到，第三名控告证人 Tseu Kung Sung 在医院陈述说，他在袭击发生时看到了第二名被告。在第14页，该证人在公开法庭作证说，第二名被告是袭击的煽动者。回到第11和12页，可以看到第四名控告证人 Hyu Sung Kyung 在医院作证说，他在袭击期间看到了第二名被告。
反对

page_data.en:
-3-

Opposing this abundant evidence, particularly against
the second accused, is the denial of the second accused
that he was concerned in the assault. He admits that he
knew an assault was contemplated, and stated that it was
his intention to report the matter to the Bureau of Social
Affairs. In an effort to bolster up a weak alibi, the
second accused called as a witness a representative of the
Bureau of Social Affairs. This witness was, however, too
eager in his evidence, for he testified that the second
accused visited him at approximately 10:10 a.m. The time
of the assault is given in the charge as 9:45 a.m. and the
witness's statement that the second accused visited him
at 10:10 a.m. evidently surprised even the second accused,
for he plainly told the Court that the time of his arrival
at the Bureau of Social Affairs was 10:45 a.m. Questioned
as to the discrepancy of 30 minutes in the second accused's
statement and that of his own, the witness from the Bureau
namely replied that "According to my time, it was 10:10 a.m.".

The Police in their case papers state that the assault
lasted only a minute or so, and was evidently pre-arranged.
There would, therefore, be ample time for the second accused
to be present at the assault as alleged by the various wit-
nesses and still put in an appearance at the Bureau of Social
Affairs an hour later.

In view of the above, the Police suggest an appeal against
the acquittal of the second and fifth accused.

Superintendent.

R.W.Y./J
page_data.zh:
-3-

反对这些大量证据（特别是针对第二名被告）的是，第二名被告否认他参与了袭击。他承认他知道有人策划袭击，并声称他打算将此事项报告给社会局。为了支撑一个薄弱的不在场证明，第二名被告传唤了一名社会局的代表作为证人。然而，这名证人在作证时过于急切，因为他作证说第二名被告大约在上午10:10拜访了他。起诉书给出的袭击时间是上午9:45，而证人关于第二名被告在上午10:10拜访他的陈述显然连第二名被告自己都感到惊讶，因为他明确告诉法庭，他到达社会局的时间是上午10:45。当被问及第二名被告的陈述与他自己的陈述之间存在30分钟的差异时，来自社会局的证人只是回答说：“根据我的时间，是上午10:10”。

警方在案件材料中指出，袭击只持续了一分钟左右，且显然是预先安排的。因此，第二名被告有充足的时间如各证人所述出现在袭击现场，并在一小时后出现在社会局。

鉴于上述情况，警方建议针对第二名和第五名被告的无罪释放提出上诉。

警司。

R.W.Y./J

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

On the morning of 28-3-33, all five accused appeared before the Court, when a further hearing took place.

The 3rd complainant Dzung Yoong Kwei was taken to Court by Detectives, and gave evidence as regards being assaulted, but either could, or would not identify any of the accused as the persons responsible, stating that the assault was committed by a large number of persons.

None of the other complainants were present in Court, it being intimated to the Judge that they were still detained in Hospital. All five witnesses were again questioned by the Judge, and then one Tsang Sung (張昇), a member of the Shanghai Kuomingtang Party from the Chinese City was called as a witness by Mr. Y.T. Van, Chinese lawyer representing 2nd accused Woo Sz Yuen (吳士元). The above man gave evidence that 2nd accused called for him shortly after 10a.m. on 20-3-33 at the Kuomingtang Party Headquarters in the Chinese City, and reported to him the trouble at the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory and also accompanied him there in a motor car. The accused however was not sure about the exact time when further questioned by the Judge.

The hearing was then adjourned by the Judge until 5-4-33, and an application for bail on behalf of the 2nd accused Won Sz Yuen (吳士元) and 5th accused Lee Sing Fah (李新發) was granted in the sum of $500.00 security, the others to remain in custody.

33年3月28日上午，五名被告全部出庭，进行了进一步审讯。

第三控告人钟永贵（Dzung Yoong Kwei，音译）由侦探带至法庭，就遭受袭击一事作证，但他要么不能、要么不愿指认任何被告为责任人，声称袭击是由一大群人实施的。

其他控告人均未出庭，向法官说明他们仍住院留医。法官再次讯问了所有五名证人，随后传召了一名来自华界的国民党党员张昇（Tsang Sung）作为代表第二被告吴士元（Woo Sz Yuen）的中国律师范先生（Mr. Y.T. Van）的证人。此人作证称，33年3月20日上午10点后不久，第二被告在华界国民党党部找他，向他报告了南洋兄弟烟草厂的纠纷，并随他乘车前往该厂。然而，当法官进一步讯问时，被告对确切时间并不确定。

随后法官宣布休庭至33年4月5日，并批准了代表第二被告吴士元（Woo Sz Yuen）和第五被告李新发（Lee Sing Fah）的保释申请，保证金为500.00美元，其余人继续羁押。

他下楼后，在警察到达之前被送往医院。已收到以下医生证明：Hyu Sung Ching（音译）。头部有一处约4英寸长的割伤。左肩淤青。右手挫伤。Tseu Kung Sung。鼻部有一处长1½英寸的穿透性割伤。双眼周围淤青。双手及双臂挫伤。

My name is Feng Hai Zien, age 19 years old, native of Zau-
shing, residing at 150 Shing Sing Li, Broadway. I am employed
as an apprentice in the Packing Department, Nanyang Brothers
Tobacco Factory. At about 10:00a.m. on 20/3/33, whilst I stood
outside the office of Packing Department, I saw many coolies
approach the Packing Department and assault the i/c, Lee Ts
Dzung (See 1st statement, i.e. 1st accused Tsang Tuh Dzung),
among those, Lee Sin Fah also took part. I saw him breaking
the windows with his hands but never saw him assaulting the
complt, Lee Ts Dzung. When the 1st accused was arrested, I
didn't see. At 3:00p.m. to-day, (22/3/33) I saw him in the Tin
Foil Department, when he explained to the Detectives of how he
was arrested.

I live at No. 22 Dong Tshaung Lee, Dent Road, and am working
in the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory, Broadway East, for about
10 years.
At about 9.50p.m. on 20-3-33, whilst I was working on the
2nd floor of the factory, I saw a crowd of male and female
workers employed in the Prepared Tobacco Department coming ups-
tairs. Some of them were armed with wooden bars, and they then
commenced to assault the Department Manager Lee Ts Daung.
I heard someone saying that it was due to the fact that Lee Ts
Daung had recently promoted more than 20 temporary workers who
had been working for either one or half year, to formal workers,
whilst he disregarded those who had already been working for
two or three years.
At about 11a.m. on 22-3-33, whilst I was in the 2nd floor
of the factory, I was pointed out by one Feng Hai Zien and
arrested by detectives who brought me to the Police Station.
My statement is true.

我居住在登特路（Dent Road）东庄里（Dong Tshaung Lee，音译）22号，在东百老汇路（Broadway East）的南洋兄弟烟草公司工作了约10年。
1933年3月20日晚上9点50分左右（原文为p.m.，结合上下文可能为a.m.之误，或确为晚间，但前文提及上午9:50，此处依原文译），当我在工厂二楼工作时，我看到一群受雇于熟烟丝部的男女工人上楼。他们中一些人手持木棍，随后开始袭击部门经理 Lee Ts Daung（音译）。
我听到有人说，这是因为 Lee Ts Daung 最近将二十多名工作了一年或半年的临时工提升为正式工，而忽视了那些已经工作了两三年的人。
1933年3月22日上午11点左右，当我在工厂二楼时，被一名 Feng Hai Zien（音译）指认，并被侦探逮捕，带我到警察局。

I live at No. 51 Dong Tsimung Lee, Broadway, and am employed
as a brass-smith in the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory for
about three years.
On 20-3-33, I went to the factory at 7a.m. At about
10a.m. I was standing on the 1st floor, when I saw a crowd of
male and female workers rushing to the 2nd floor and heard some-
one saying that a fighting was taking place upstairs. I then
went there, but saw that the crowd had dispersed and the glasses
of the windows smashed. I heard some bystanders stating that
the Department Manager Lee Ts Daug had been injured. Later
I returned to my work place and did not know actually what had
happened. My statement is true .

我居住在百老汇路（Broadway）东新民里（Dong Tsimung Lee，音译）51号，在南洋兄弟烟草公司担任铜匠约三年。
1933年3月20日，我早上7点去工厂。上午10点左右，我站在一楼，看到一群男女工人冲向二楼，并听到有人说楼上正在打架。于是我去了那里，但看到人群已经散去，窗户玻璃破碎。我听到一些旁观者说部门经理 Lee Ts Daug（音译）受伤了。后来我回到工作岗位，并不确切知道发生了什么。我的陈述属实。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 43
Wayside Station,
REPORT
Date March 21st, 19 33.
Subject (in full) Further information regarding assault and trouble at Nanyang
Brothers Tobacco Factory,
Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Wardrop.

Sir,
On 21/3/33, the 1st accused in this case appeared before the
Court and was remanded until 28/3/33.
During the day two further arrests were made, and four
witnesses located. Statements were taken from all the above
persons which are attached to Diary No.2 of F.I.R.475/33, a copy
of diary and statements being forwarded herewith.
Woo Sz Yuen (吴士元), the 2nd accused voluntarily ceased
work in above factory on January 7th, 1933, and together with 1st
accused has since been the prime mover in organizing the recently
formed union, and presenting the workers demands to the Factory
Management.
A strong force of Police and Detectives were on duty in the
vicinity of the factory entrances during the day, but no trouble
occurred, and work proceeded as usual.
Rumours were prevelent that a meeting would be held about
2:00p.m. on 21/3/33 in the Ningpo Fellow Countrymens' Guild, Thibet
Road, but this did not take place.
Rumours are also prevelant that the disaffected section of
the workers will make an attempt at sabotage also assault loyal
workers when the factory opens for work at 6:30a.m. on 22/3/33.
In consequence of above a strong force of Police and Detec-
tives will be on duty both inside and outside the factory from
6:00a.m. 22/3/33 until it is known that the danger is past.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
R. Wardrop.
Officer i/c. Special Branch. D. I.
(批：Ph)

主题（完整）关于南洋兄弟烟草公司袭击及骚乱的进一步信息，
由督察 Wardrop 制作并提交。

先生，
1933年3月21日，本案第一被告出庭，案件延期至1933年3月28日审理。
当天又进行了两次逮捕，并找到了四名证人。已对上述所有人录取陈述，附于初步调查报告475/33号的日志第2号后，日志及陈述副本随函附上。
Woo Sz Yuen（吴士元），第二被告，于1933年1月7日自愿停止在上述工厂工作，此后与第一被告一起成为组织新近成立的工会并向工厂管理层提出工人要求的主要发起者。
白天，大量警察和侦探在工厂入口附近执勤，但未发生骚乱，工作照常进行。
有谣言称，1933年3月21日下午2点左右将在西藏路宁波同乡会举行会议，但该会议并未举行。
另有谣言称，不满的工人部分将在1933年3月22日早上6:30工厂开工时，企图进行破坏，并袭击忠诚的工人。
鉴于上述情况，从1933年3月22日早上6:00起，直到确认危险过去为止，将有大量警察和侦探在工厂内外执勤。
此致，
敬礼，
您的顺从仆人，
R. Wardrop.

案件延期审理后，证人彭来连陪同侦探进入法院大院，仔细辨认在场人员，并立即指认一名在场的华籍男子为其供词中提及的第一号人物（王麻皮）。

The following is the statement of Woo Sz Yuen, 33,
native of Anhwei, taken by me C.D.S. 62,

at Wayside on the 21-3-33 and interpreted by Clerk Loo

I was born in Chinkiang, Kiangsu. In about 8th or 9th year
of the Republic, I became an apprentice in a Coal and Iron Shop,
at Tsai Tsu Fong, Changchow, During the 11th year, I came to
Shanghai, and lived at No. 30 Yulin Li, Yulin Road. Two years
latter, one of my friend Tsah Yi Ming (ex- C.P.C. 788) introduced
me to work in the Packing Department of Nanyang Brothers Tobacco
Factory. I have been working there for more than 9 years.

On 1/2-2-33, some of the workers suggested to me to organize
a Workers' Office, and 9 persons named Siau Kwang Tuh, Tseng Zung
Foo, Tsang Tuh Dzung (1st accused), Wong Kyi Sung, Woo Zu Tsang,
Dzung ing, Mang Tsang, Tsang Ah Tsang, and I were elected to
take up this affair. We then wrote a letter to the 4th District
Cigarette Factory Workers' Union informing them of the case. A
Representative of the Union was sent to the factory to make enqui-
ries, and no objection was given.

On 10-2-33, the Shanghai Labour's Union gave approval for the
organization of such an office, and we rented a room at 425 Yui Chi
ng, Li, Seward Road, as the workers' office. The inaugurating
ceremony was held at the Ningpo Fellow-country-men Association
on Thibet Road, at 1p.m. on 12-3-33, and a Standing Committee of
22 persons were elected. It included the above named 9 persons,
and the names of other 13 persons were □□, Kong Pao, Dzung Loong,
Zien Tsu Pao, Zien Nyung, Voong, Tsang Ah Ying, Wong Ah Chao,
Kong Ah Tsu, Nyung Yoong Kung, Ong Ling, Tseu Li, and 3 others
names unknown to me. On 16-3-33, we obtained an information
that the management would dismiss all the workers who were members
of the Office. We then immediately held a meeting to discuss the
case, and 6 demands were decided to be forwarded to the management.

警方调查报告。

以下为吴士元（Woo Sz Yuen），33岁，安徽籍，由我（刑事侦缉警员编号62）于1933年3月21日在路边巡捕房录取，并由书记员卢（Loo）翻译的供词。

我出生于江苏镇江。民国八九年左右，我在常州蔡子坊（Tsai Tsu Fong，音译）的一家煤铁店当学徒。民国十一年，我来到上海，居住在榆林路榆林里30号。两年后，我的朋友查义明（Tsah Yi Ming，音译，前中央政治委员会第788号成员）介绍我到南洋兄弟烟草公司包装部工作。我在那里工作已超过九年。

1933年2月1日，一些工人建议我组织一个“工人办事处”，选举萧光德（Siau Kwang Tuh，音译）、曾宗福（Tseng Zung Foo，音译）、张堆章（Tsang Tuh Dzung，即第一被告）、黄奇松（Wong Kyi Sung，音译）、吴祖昌（Woo Zu Tsang，音译）、钟英（Dzung ing，音译）、孟章（Mang Tsang，音译）、张阿章（Tsang Ah Tsang）和我共九人负责此事。随后我们致函第四区卷烟厂工会告知此事。工会派代表到工厂查询，未提出异议。

1933年2月10日，上海劳工联合会批准成立该办事处，我们在西华德路余庆里425号租用了一间房间作为工人办事处。1933年3月12日下午1时，在西藏路宁波同乡会举行了成立仪式，选举产生了由22人组成的常务委员会。其中包括上述九人，其余13人的姓名为□□、孔宝（Kong Pao，音译）、钟龙（Dzung Loong，音译）、钱子宝（Zien Tsu Pao，音译）、钱荣（Zien Nyung，音译）、冯（Voong，音译）、张阿英（Tsang Ah Ying，音译）、黄阿超（Wong Ah Chao，音译）、孔阿珠（Kong Ah Tsu，音译）、杨永根（Nyung Yoong Kung，音译）、翁玲（Ong Ling，音译）、谢李（Tseu Li，音译），另有三人姓名我不清楚。1933年3月16日，我们得到消息，资方将解雇所有身为办事处成员的工人。我们随即召开会议讨论此事，决定向资方提出六项要求。

These were:- (1) that the management of the factory be requested
to properly recognise the // Shanghai Cigarette Factory Workers'
Union, (2) that no workers should be dismissed without any apparent
reasons, (3) that the present wages be increased, (4) that the
management be requested to give $500. to the Workers' Office,
(5) that an increase of 2 cents per 1,000 cigarette and 0.2 cents
per 10 packets be authorised to the workers of the Packing Room,
(6) that the old regulations between workers and capitalist will
be in effect until the new one is signed. On 17-3-33, the
management gave us a reply stating that they would give us an
answer regarding the above demands two or three days later.

At about 10a.m. on 20-3-33, whilst I was in my home, a Ningpo
man came and told me that the workers of the factory had stopped
work. I did not believe this, so I telephoned to the factory, and
found that what he had told me was true. I then went to report
this to the Shanghai Kuo Min Tang Party, and there I informed the
Social Affairs Bureau through 'phone. At about 12 noon, I, accom-
panied by the representatives of Kuomintang Party Tsang Sung,
the Shanghai Labour Union representatives named Tan Yah Lai and
Lau Shu Fan, and also the 4th District Cigarette Factory Workers'
Union's representative Tseu Yah Ming, went to see the general
manager of the factory. He was out, so we spoke to his law-
yer Lo Ling Kwen. We talked over with him about the above 6
demands, and he allowed to give us an answer on 21-3-33. After
this, we went upstairs and told all the workers to resume work,
we again told them that the lawyer would ask the Police to release
the arrested person Tsang Tun Dzung, and that he had given allowed
us to give us a satisfactory answer regarding the demands.

这些要求是：(1) 请求工厂资方正视//上海卷烟厂工人工会；(2) 不得无故解雇工人；(3) 增加现有工资；(4) 请求资方向工人办事处提供500元；(5) 授权包装部工人每千支香烟增加2分津贴，每十包增加0.2分津贴；(6) 在新规签署之前，工人与资本家之间的旧规章继续有效。1933年3月17日，资方回复称，两三天后就上述要求给予答复。

1933年3月20日上午10时左右，我在家中时，一名宁波人来告诉我，工厂工人已罢工。我不相信，于是打电话到工厂，发现他说的是事实。我便去向中国国民党上海市党部报告，并通过电话通知了社会局。中午12时左右，我陪同国民党代表张松（Tsang Sung，音译）、上海劳工联合会代表谭亚来（Tan Yah Lai，音译）和刘树藩（Lau Shu Fan，音译），以及第四区卷烟厂工会代表朱亚明（Tseu Yah Ming，音译），去见工厂总经理。他不在，于是我们与他的律师罗灵昆（Lo Ling Kwen，音译）交谈。我们就上述六项要求与他商谈，他答应在1933年3月21日给予答复。之后，我们上楼告诉所有工人复工，并再次告诉他们，律师会请求警方释放被捕人员张堆章（Tsang Tun Dzung，音译），并且他已答应就各项要求给予我们满意的答复。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Lao Ah Ching, 23,
native of Tungchow, taken by me C.D.C. 248,
translated
at Wayside Stn. on the 21-3-33 and interpreted by Clerk Loo.

I live at No. 519 Tullin Road and am working as a coolie in
the Tin Foil Department on the 2nd floor of Nanyang Brothers
Tobacco Factory.

At 5p.m. on 19-3-33, I was released from work, when in the
factory, I met one Tsang Tuh Dzung. He told me that I had been
working as a temporary coolie in the factory for more than two
years, but the manager had no idea of promoting me to be a formal
coolie, and that he could dismiss me at any time if he liked.

At about 10a.m. on 21-3-33, whilst I was working in the factory,
Tsang Tuh Zung came and ordered all of us to stop work. I did so
and sat silently in a corner. I did not go out, but I saw many
coolies running to and fro in the factory. At about 11.15a.m.,
I heard someone talking that Tsang Tuh Dzung and Lau Ching Tsui
had led several other coolies to assault the Department Manager
Leo Ta Deung, and seriously injured him. As the place of the
assault was far away from my department, so I did not see what
had occurred. Between 21-3-33 and 26-3-33, I was on leave and
in my country place, therefore I did not know anything about any
meeting held by the workers.

My statement is true.

Signed.

以下为老阿清（Lao Ah Ching，音译），23岁，通州籍，由我（刑事侦缉警员编号248）于1933年3月21日在路边巡捕房录取，并由书记员卢（Loo）翻译的供词。

我居住在图林路519号，在南洋兄弟烟草公司二楼锡箔部做苦力。

1933年3月19日下午5时，我下班时在工厂内遇到张堆章（Tsang Tuh Dzung）。他告诉我，我在工厂做临时苦力已有两年多，但经理无意将我转为正式苦力，如果他愿意，可以随时解雇我。

1933年3月21日上午10时左右，当我在工厂工作时，张堆章（Tsang Tuh Zung，音译）过来命令我们所有人停工。我照做了，静静地坐在角落里。我没有出去，但我看到许多苦力在工厂里跑来跑去。上午11点15分左右，我听到有人说，张堆章（Tsang Tuh Dzung）和刘清翠（Lau Ching Tsui，音译）带领其他几名苦力袭击部门经理李达登（Leo Ta Deung，音译），并将其重伤。由于袭击地点离我所在的部门很远，所以我没有看到发生的情况。1933年3月21日至3月26日期间，我正在休假回老家，因此我对工人举行的任何会议一无所知。

我的供词属实。

签名。

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Feng Hai Lien, 19,
native of Zaushing, taken by me C.D.C. 258,
at Wayside Station on the 21-3-33 and translated and interpreted by Clerk Loo.

I live at No. 459. Shing Ching Li, Broadway, and am working
in the Packing Department of Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory.
At about 10 a.m. on 20-3-33, I saw more than 200 male and female
workers led by Tsang Tuh Dzu, Bau Ching Tsui, Lu S h Ching, and
a pock marked person, proceeding to an office on the 2nd floor.
The Department Manager Lee Ts Daung and Assistant Department Mana-
ger Lee Lung Yao immediately closed the office door, when they
saw the crowd approaching them. Tseng Tuh Dzung and the pock
marked person then ordered the other coolies to break the window
glasses and force open the door. They then assaulted the two
managers by means of iron bars and wooden trays. Later Tsang Tuh
Dzung was arrested by police and brought before the Court, when I
appeared as witness. After the case had been tried, I left the
Court, when I met the pock-marked person,. I at once called a
detective to arrest him. He gives his name as Loo Sz Yuen.
He was the very person who took part in the assault.
My statement is true.

Signed.

以下为冯海连（Feng Hai Lien，音译），19岁，赵兴（Zaushing，音译）籍，由我（刑事侦缉警员编号258）于1933年3月21日在路边巡捕房录取，并由书记员卢（Loo）翻译和口译的供词。

我居住在百老汇路星庆里459号，在南洋兄弟烟草公司包装部工作。1933年3月20日上午10时左右，我看见二百多名男女工人在张堆章（Tsang Tuh Dzu，音译）、鲍清翠（Bau Ching Tsui，音译）、陆世清（Lu S h Ching，音译）和一个麻脸人的带领下，前往二楼的一间办公室。部门经理李达登（Lee Ts Daung，音译）和副部门经理李龙耀（Lee Lung Yao，音译）看到人群向他们逼近时，立即关上了办公室的门。随后，张堆章（Tseng Tuh Dzung，音译）和那个麻脸人命令其他苦力打破窗玻璃并强行破门。随后他们用铁条和木托盘袭击了两名经理。后来张堆章被警察逮捕并带上法庭，我作为证人出庭。庭审结束后，我离开法院时遇到了那个麻脸人。我立即叫来一名侦探将其逮捕。他自报姓名为罗士元（Loo Sz Yuen，音译）。他就是参与袭击的那个人。
我的供词属实。

签名。

I live at No. 4 Zung Fah Li, Chaoufoong Road, and am working as a coolie in the Cigarette Department of the Nanyang/Tobacco Factory.

At about 10a.m. on 20-3-33, whilst I and several other coolies were working in the factory, two men came and told us to stop work. We did so, and went downstairs to the Cutting Department to see what had happened. We saw a group of persons, more than 20, all armed with iron bars or wooden stools, assaulted another man whose name is unknown to me. Two of the attackers named Tsung Tuh Dzung and Wong S cried, "Strike, strike". After they had injured the unknown person, they proceeded to the 2nd floor, and I did not know what happened later. My statement is true.

我住在兆丰路（Chaoufoong Road）宗法里 4 号，在南洋烟草厂卷烟部做苦力。

1933 年 3 月 20 日上午 10 点左右，我和其他几名苦力正在工厂工作时，有两个人来叫我们停工。我们照做了，并下楼去切割部查看发生了什么事。我们看到一群二十多人，都手持铁条或木凳，殴打另一名我不知其姓名的人。两名袭击者名叫 Tsung Tuh Dzung 和 Wong S，高喊“罢工，罢工”。在伤害了那名不明身份的人之后，他们前往二楼，之后发生了什么我就不知道了。我的陈述属实。

Sir,
Subsequent to the assault mentioned in F.I.R.475/33, it was
ascertained that on 18/3/33, the following demands were made by
the representatives of the workers who recently organized a Union
with Offices at No.425 Tsung Vung Ka, off Yu Ching Li, East
Seward Road.

The demands are stated to be as follows:-
(1) That the newly formed Union be recognized by the Manage-
ment.
(2) No workers to be dismissed without good reason.
(3) That $500:00 be paid montly by the Company towards the
Union funds.
(4) That an increase in wages be granted to the female workers
in the tin foil department.
(5) That a bonus of 8 days, extra pay be paid monthly.

The management did not give a definite reply but stated that
the demands would be considered.

At a meeting held in the factory at mid-day 20/3/33, attended
by the Management, Wu Ling Kung (吴麟冲), Legal Adviser of the
above Company, Wong Ping (王平) of the Bureau of Social Affairs
and representative of the Shanghai Koumingtang Party the following
further demand was made by the Section of the workers:-

That the management petition the Police to release Tsang
Tuh Dzung.

As the result of instructions received by the lawyer Wu Ling
Kung, from the directors of the Nayang Brothers Tobacco Factory,
he visited this Station about 3:30p.m. on 20/3/33 and advised
the D.O. and D.D.O."D" that the management of above factory wished
the Police to proceed against Tsang Tuh Dzung. The three persons

先生，
继首次报案记录 475/33 中提到的袭击事件后，经查实，1933 年 3 月 18 日，最近组织成立工会的工人代表提出了以下要求，该工会办事处位于东熙华德路（East Seward Road）裕庆里外的宗庸街（Tsung Vung Ka，音译）425 号。

据称要求如下：-
(1) 管理层承认新成立的工会。
(2) 无正当理由不得解雇工人。
(3) 公司每月向工会基金支付 500.00 元。
(4) 给予锡箔部女工加薪。
(5) 每月发放相当于 8 天工资的额外奖金。

管理层未给予明确答复，但表示将考虑这些要求。

1933 年 3 月 20 日中午，在工厂举行的一次会议上，出席者包括管理层、上述公司的法律顾问吴麟冲（Wu Ling Kung）、社会局官员王平（Wong Ping）以及国民党上海党部代表，工人方面提出了以下进一步要求：-

要求管理层向警方请愿，释放 Tsang Tuh Dzung。

由于南洋兄弟烟草厂董事向律师吴麟冲发出指示，他于 1933 年 3 月 20 日下午 3:30 左右访问了本巡捕房，并告知分区警官（D.O.）和副分区警官（D.D.O.）“D”区，上述工厂管理层希望警方对 Tsang Tuh Dzung 提起诉讼。这三名

who were assaulted who had previously stated that they did not

were then interviewed and informed that the management wished
that accused be charged, and then in the presence of Lawyer Wu Ling Kung
signed a formal complaint of assault, the 1st and 2nd signing it
in the Paulun Hospital and the 3rd in his home at No.32 Pah Loh
Faung, Broadway.
After the assault and arrest of Tsang Tuh Dzung the workers
remained on the premises, only a small number of them however
continued with their work.
It would appear that the underlying reason for the assault
is that there are two factions in the factory, one which the
assaulted persons belong to, being loyal to the management of the
factory and the other to which the accused and others are reputed to
belong to, being followers of one Li Hwei (李輝 ) who formerly
worked in the factory as works manager.
The above Li Hwei is stated to have been responsible for the
misappropriation of a large amount of money during 1932. This
was discovered about the end of January 1933, since when Li Hwei has
been replaced, and negotiations have since been going on with Tueh Yoeh
Sung as mediator.
Nothing has been settled owing to the fact that Li Hwei is
stated to be in possession of the books concerned and for this
reason there is bad feeling between the different factions and is
believed to be the reason for the trouble in the factory, although
no one will admit it.
Lee Ts Daung has been employed for 2 years and 8 months.
Lee Zung Yao, brother of above has been employed for 1 month.
Dzung Yoong Kwei, has been employed for 16 days and is learning

此前曾表示不愿采取任何行动、称此事为公司内部事务的遇袭者随后接受了问询，并被告知管理层希望控告被告，随后在律师吴麟冲在场的情况下签署了正式的袭击控告书，第一和第二位受害者在宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital）签署，第三位在其百老汇路（Broadway）白劳坊（Pah Loh Faung，音译）32 号的家中签署。
在 Tsang Tuh Dzung 被袭击和逮捕后，工人们仍留在厂区内，但只有少数人继续工作。
看来，袭击的根本原因是工厂内存在两派势力，一派是遇袭者所属的，效忠于工厂管理层；另一派是被告等人据称所属的，是李辉（Li Hwei）的追随者，李辉曾任该厂工务经理。
据称，上述李辉在 1932 年期间侵吞了大量资金。此事于 1933 年 1 月底被发现，此后李辉被替换，并由 Tueh Yoeh Sung（音译）作为调解人进行谈判。
由于据称李辉持有相关账簿，事情尚未解决，因此各派系之间关系恶劣，这被认为是工厂骚乱的原因，尽管无人承认这一点。
Lee Ts Daung 已受雇 2 年 8 个月。
Lee Zung Yao，上述人员之弟，已受雇 1 个月。

At 10.5a.m. 20-8-36, a telephone message was received from Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory, No. 289 East Broadway, stating that there was trouble there and that a number of persons had been injured.

A party of Uniform Police and Detectives immediately proceeded to the East Broadway entrance of the factory, and gaining entrance discovered that work was at a stand-still.

Proceeding to the 2nd floor in a small office at the top of the landing attached to the Packing Department, it was discovered that 33 windows in the office were broken, and the furniture upset and broken, Two male Chinese bleeding from wounds on the head, face, and hands were being attended to by male and female workers. The statements of the 1st and 2nd injured persons were that they were in their office on the 2nd floor of above factory at 9.45a.m. on 20-3-33, when the machinery stopped and a large crowd of male and female workers led by the accused Tsang Tuh Dung, and two others not arrested named Lau Ching Tsai (趙金川) and Sung Ah Ching (陳阿全) approached the office on 2nd floor and demanded admittance, which was refused. The crowd of male and female outside led by the above accused and the other two named persons then broke the windows of the office and opened the door by inserting their hands.

Led by the above persons, the crowd then rushed into the room, accused then picked up a chair and struck the 2nd complainant Lee Zung Yao on the head with it, then using the broken pieces of various articles of furniture in the room, several of the persons including the accused, the persons mentioned by name and several others not identified, committed a general assault on both 1st and 2nd complainants, beating them about the head and body, and knocking them to the floor. During the assault, the furniture in the room was overturned and the room wrecked. The assault only lasted about half a minute, and the assailants then ran out of the room.

第一和第二伤者的陈述称，1933年3月20日上午9时45分，他们正在上述工厂二楼的办公室内，当时机器停止运转，一大群男女工人在被告张德成（Tsang Tuh Dung，音译）以及两名未被逮捕者赵金川（Lau Ching Tsai，音译）和陈阿全（Sung Ah Ching，音译）的带领下，走近二楼办公室并要求进入，但遭到拒绝。随后，由上述被告及另外两名具名人员带领的门外男女人群砸碎了办公室窗户，并伸手进去打开了门。

在上述人员的带领下，人群冲入房间，被告随即拿起一把椅子击打第二报案人李忠尧（Lee Zung Yao，音译）的头部，随后利用房间内各种家具的碎片，包括被告、具名人员及其他数名身份不明者在内的多人，对第一和第二报案人进行了普遍殴打，击打他们的头部和身体，并将他们打倒在地。在殴打过程中，房间内的家具被掀翻，房间遭到破坏。殴打仅持续了约半分钟，随后袭击者跑出房间。

3rd complainant stated that about 9.45a.m. 20-3-33, he was sitting in the office of the ground floor when a large crowd of male and female workers led by the accused, invaded the office, and assaulted him with pieces of wood, and iron bars, about the head, body, and legs, overturned the furniture, and broke windows in the office.

This witness is unable to name who actually struck him, but states that the accused was amongst and part of the crowd who committed the assault and damage to his office.

Enquiries were made by Detectives amongst the factory workers both male and female, but no one would come forward to gave any details of the assault or the reason for same.

Laterly, one Fang Hai Tien (冯海添) employed in the Packing Department on the 2nd floor came forward and stated that he had witnessed the assault, and named the accused, also Dzu g Ah Ching (朱阿金), Zau Ching Tsai (趙金才) previously mentioned, also one Siau Moq Bi (小麻皮) about 10a.m. 20-3-33, rush into the packing department office, armed with bars and pieces of wood and assault the 1st and 2nd complainants. States he is unable to give any reason for the assault. Statements attached.

a demand was made on the management by a newly organized
workers union that the Union be recognised, also that
concessions be made regarding increase of wages and dis-
missal of workers.

报案人称他们无法提供殴打的原因。第一和第二报案人目前留院治疗于伯基尔路415号宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital），他们在离开警局后入住该院。第三报案人目前在家卧床，他们在数日内均无法出庭。

Wayside Stn.            20/3/33           translated   Clerk Loo.

    I live at No.459A Shing Ching Li, Broadway, and am working in
the packing department of Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory.
    At about 10a.m. on 20/3/33, I saw several of my co-workers
named Tsang Tuh Sung, Dzung Ah Ching, Zau Ching Tsai, and Siau
Moo Bi, each armed with an iron bar acting as leadership together
with about 200 male and female workers of the factory, all armed
with wooden or iron bars, rushed into the packing department
office on the 2nd floor, and assaulted one Li Zung Yao and two
others. They were injured and fell to the ground. The group
then decamped and dispersed. My statement is true.

    我居住在百老汇路盛庆里459A号，在南洋兄弟烟草公司包装部工作。
    1933年3月20日上午10点左右，我看见几名同事，名为张德松（Tsang Tuh Sung，音译）、朱阿金（Dzung Ah Ching，音译）、赵金才（Zau Ching Tsai，音译）和小麻皮（Siau Moo Bi，音译），每人手持一根铁条作为领头，连同约200名工厂男女工人，均手持木棒或铁条，冲入二楼包装部办公室，殴打了李忠尧（Li Zung Yao，音译）及另外两人。他们受伤倒地。随后该群人逃离并散去。我的陈述属实。

Tsang Tuh Sung, 44,
Shantung, C.D.C. 306,
Wayside 20-3-33 translated XXXXXXXX Clerk Loo.

I am employed as a coolie-foreman in the Tobacco Leaf Room
of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory, 144 East Seward Road,
and am living in the factory.

At about 10a.m. on 20-3-33, whilst I was working in the To-
bacco Leaf Room. I saw about more than 200 male and female work-
ers gathered inside the factory. Twenty of the male workers,
whose name were unknown to me, approached me, and requested me
to accompany them/to the office of Feng Kya Zang in order to talk over
with him about the question of the increasing of wages. I agreed
and joined with them. Upon arriving at Feng's office, we found
that he was not there, so we went to the Packing Department's
office on the 2nd floor, where we tried to talk/over the question with
Lee Ts Daung. He however scolded us before we spoke to/him, which
greatly excited all the workers. A quarrel then arose, with
the result that he was assaulted and injured. During the con-
flict, I returned to my room, and was later arrested by detec-
tives from the Police Station.

I did not actually see who assaulted Lee Ts Laung.

My statement is true.
page_data.zh:
张德松（Tsang Tuh Sung，音译），44岁，
山东籍，C.D.C. 306，
路边站 1933年3月20日 翻译 XXXXXXXX 录事陆（Loo）。

我在东熙华德路144号南洋兄弟烟草公司的烟叶房受雇为苦力领班，并居住在工厂内。

1933年3月20日上午10点左右，当我正在烟叶房工作时，我看见200多名男女工人聚集在工厂内。20名男工人，姓名不详，走近我，请求我陪同他们前往冯家章（Feng Kya Zang，音译）的办公室，与他商谈增加工资的问题。我同意并加入了他们。到达冯的办公室后，我们发现他不在，于是我们去了二楼包装部的办公室，试图与李慈堂（Lee Ts Daung，音译）商谈此事。然而，在我们与他交谈之前，他便辱骂我们，这极大地激怒了所有工人。随后发生争吵，导致他被殴打受伤。在冲突期间，我回到了自己的房间，后来被警局警探逮捕。

我并未亲眼看到谁殴打了李慈堂（Lee Ts Laung，音译）。

我的陈述属实。

Bureau, the management and the workers were present.

cause. They demanded reinstatement.

that the men had been dismissed for having violated the 
rules of the Company and that it was impossible to accept 
the demand for reinstatement. 

Owing to the firm attitude adopted by both 


sides, the mediation had no result. ‘
